Nothing was built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **The diff is one inserted line** at the end of D5, before the D6 heading; no existing sentence is edited, moved or deleted, so no ruled decision text changes. RIGHT.

2. **True of the code**, clause by clause against PR #23884 at 70b3cb0927:
   - "under a walled posture the deployment-level acceptance of package defaults for the `everyone` anchor (ADR-0090 D5) is configuration too — the security plugin's `acceptedDefaultPermissionSets` option": `SecurityPluginOptions.acceptedDefaultPermissionSets`, declared, is the sole deployment-level acceptance `readAcceptedEveryoneSets` derives `everyone` from. RIGHT.
   - "read only under a wall": `hostDeclaredAcceptance` reads it only when `postureEnforcesWall(posture)` holds, and a declaration under `single` is refused at `start()`. RIGHT.
   - "each name held to the anchor's ADR-0090 D7 gate": `describeAnchorForbiddenBits(definition, 'everyone', capabilities)` is asked of every declared name on every derivation, beside the catalog-serves, package-owned and `isDefault` checks the line does not claim but which also hold. RIGHT.
   - "with no NULL-owner row and no reserved organization (§1.5)": the declared path writes no row and reads none; no organization is created, reserved or implied; section 1.5's rejected shape is named as rejected. RIGHT.
   - "the `single` posture keeps its Default-Organization row": `NO_RECORD_OWNER_MESSAGE` and the record path are unchanged under `single`. RIGHT.

3. **Form.** The sentence form — `**Amended** (date, card — authority): text` — is the record's own, the status line's 2026-09-17 note being the precedent, and the authority named is the maintainer's ruling A′ on objectstack-ai/cloud#2872, item 3, as triage quoted and verified it. RIGHT. Position: the record's two precedents are the status-line note and an end `## Amendment` section; an inline paragraph at the end of D5 is a third position. One line, Tier H, landed by the maintainer's hand, who may move it to the status-line slot (the body offers that). The position is the maintainer's call and does not fail the record.

4. **Citations.** ADR-0090 D5 is the decision that the built-in `everyone` position carries default grants; ADR-0090 D7's linter row "High-privilege bits on an everyone-bound set → block" is the gate the code cites; ADR-0131 D5 "Platform standing is configuration" is the decision the line extends; section 1.5 is the rejected reserved organization. Each RIGHT.

5. **Consistency with the rest of the record.** D7 (deployment-level state has no organization column) and D11 (postures differ only in enforcement) are not contradicted: the line adds a configuration path under the wall and leaves `single`'s row, which is the posture split D5 itself already makes for platform standing. ADR-0090 Alternatives 3 — an environment-level `defaultPermissionSets` setting, rejected as a second distribution channel outside the position system — is not contradicted either: the option feeds the `everyone` position's derivation, which remains the one channel the explain path reads. The line could say so in a few words; optional.

6. **Ordering.** The line names an option `main` does not have until PR #23884 lands; the body states the landing order (the companion first, or together). RIGHT and necessary.

7. **Hygiene.** No model identifier and no angle bracket in the inserted line; the ruling quotation in the body is kept in its original language. RIGHT.

### ② Semver level

Publishes nothing: the single path is under `docs/adr/`, no package is touched, and the PR carries `skip-changeset`. Check Changeset on this head: the run after the label landed reads `skipped`, which the expected-skips roster names as the designed state for exactly that label; the earlier run concluded `failure` before the label landed, the sequence the roster's own description describes. RIGHT: no changeset owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Open question 4 (where the line sits): A, the end of D5, accepted as reviewed; the status-line note is the record's one-line precedent, and moving the sentence there changes nothing it claims. The maintainer decides at the hand-merge.
- Landing tier: `docs/adr/**` is Tier H in `GOVERNED_SURFACES`. This record is the contract-tier review of record, not the landing authority — the landing is the maintainer's hand or an authorized APPROVED review, and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` (success on this head) holds it there. The dev report's "the seat lands it" applies to PR #23884 only.
- Dev deviation 4: the body names PR #23884 by branch, not by number; the seat may add the cross-link.
- Check-runs on this head: all 43 completed; every gate-carrying job is `success` (Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core 1 to 6 and the aggregate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Documentation Links, Check PR Size, both single-writer guards, the Part-of and claim guards); Build Core, Build Docs, Console Pin Gate, the Dogfood shards and Verify CLI, Packed-tarball smoke and Temporal Conformance are skipped as the roster expects for a docs-only PR run; Check Changeset as under ②. No local run.
- The cloud-side adoption (dropping the boot-log warn check ruling A′ added to cloud#2709) is cloud's, at a later pin, and is not this record's.
- Order: land PR #23884 first, or both together, so the record never names an option `main` lacks.
